articles.summary: Verde is pleased to report additional assay results from its ongoing drilling program at the Minas Americas Global Alliance Project in Minas Gerais, Brazil.
articles.title: Verde AgriTech Reports New Best Intercept: 13.0 m at 0.83% TREO including 8.0 m at 1.01% TREO; 25% of Drilled Metres ≥0.40% TREO
